snippet.title: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs | Release Trailer | Roguelike Tower Defense
snippet.description:
🎮 We're Gonna Need More Fireballs is out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037670/Were_Gonna_Need_More_Fireballs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=fb_release_trailer

Indie roguelike tower defense game in pixel art. One castle, a swarm counted in hundreds of thousands. Out now.

▶ All trailers, gameplay and Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUb_4GHFlRsU

How far did you get before the swarm got you? Tell us in the comments!

🔥 We're Gonna Need More Fireballs: a tower defence game about holding one castle against a swarm counted in hundreds of thousands.
